mapper.sql: s.station_id, s.station_name, s.station_code, s.merchant_id, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.marker_icon_url, s.marker_size, s.total_piles, s.available_piles, s.occupying_piles, s.open_time, s.close_time, s.parking_fee, s.service_phone, s.facilities_info, s.images, s.station_status, s.create_time, s.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_charging_station s WHERE s.station_status = '1'

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS name, s.address, s.latitude AS lat, s.longitude AS lng, s.total_piles AS totalPiles, s.available_piles AS freePiles, s.parking_fee AS parkFee, s.open_time, s.close_time, ROUND(6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT( POW(SIN((#{lat} - s.latitude) * PI() / 360), 2) + COS(#{lat} * PI() / 180) * COS(s.latitude * PI() / 180) * POW(SIN((#{lng} - s.longitude) * PI() / 360), 2) )), 1) AS distance, s.station_status AS stationStatus FROM stad_charging_station s WHERE s.station_status = '1' AND (s.station_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_charging_station s WHERE s.station_status = '1' AND (s.station_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT s.station_name AS name, CONCAT(s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address) AS address FROM stad_charging_station s WHERE s.station_status = '1' AND (s.station_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) LIMIT 10
SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(s.province, s.city) AS code, s.city AS name FROM stad_charging_station s WHERE s.city IS NOT NULL AND s.city != '' ORDER BY s.city

SELECT r.rate_id AS rateId, r.rate_name AS rateName, r.pile_type AS pileType, rp.period_id AS periodId, rp.period_name AS periodName, DATE_FORMAT(rp.start_time, '%H:%i') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(rp.end_time, '%H:%i') AS endTime, rp.energy_price AS electricPrice, rp.service_fee AS servicePrice, rp.total_price AS totalPrice FROM stad_charging_rate r LEFT JOIN stad_charging_rate_period rp ON r.rate_id = rp.rate_id WHERE r.station_id = #{stationId} AND r.is_active = 1 ORDER BY r.sort_order, rp.sort_order
SELECT s.station_name AS name, 0 AS `count` FROM stad_charging_station s WHERE s.station_status = '1' ORDER BY s.total_piles DESC LIMIT 10
